marble.lead: There are a number of projects using marble, as both an accent and a main surface texture.
marble.tail: It's one of my favorite surfaces and actually more durable and not as expensive as some might think.

table.lead: Tables - a multipurpose anchor of many rooms - have been hand picked throughout my interior projects.

kitchen.lead: The kitchen is the heart of the home and one of my favorite projects to work on.

jack white.lead: Jack White is probably my favorite creative person, ever. A huge inspiration.

nordstrom.lead: I worked at Nordstrom for 8 years in various creative leadership roles.
nordstrom.tail: The projects below span design systems, editorial content strategy, national brand launches and many others.

images.composition: Shot from the bedroom through open double doors, the copper tub centered under the crystal chandelier, dark indigo walls framing the brighter bath beyond.
Cream buffalo mark centered over a desert basin, mesas along the horizon, ocotillo in the near ground.
Straight-on wide of the range wall, green cabinet towers flanking a white hood over marble, the oak island and four stools front and center.
Eye-level view of a limestone fireplace wall, symmetrical art hang above a wood mantel, record shelf at left, sofa entering the foreground.
Three-quarter studio portrait against saturated orange seamless, the model mid-motion in a pink blazer over a camel polka dot dress.

subjects: painting of horseback riders under a storm sky
sliding glass doors onto a covered porch
images.composition: Three-quarter vantage from the room's corner, asymmetric, with the leather sofa back running as a horizontal bar across the lower third and the ceiling beam angling in from the top left.
contrast: rough stone against smooth leather
matte textiles against glossy glass and brass
pale wall against dark plank floor
gilt ornament against a plain masonry plane
warm leather against cool grey rug
images.focal: The eye lands on the large gilt-framed monochrome painting centred over the mantel, and the two smaller gold frames flanking it keep it there.
images.balance: The gallery wall, bookshelf and ladder shelf crowd the centre and right, and the blank stone field beside the fireplace plus the open dark floor in front of it pay for that crowding.

subjects: painting of four riders on horseback under a storm sky
dried pampas-type grasses in a stoneware vase
images.composition: Dead-on frontal vantage, near mirror symmetry about the fireplace, with the mantel beam and the sofa back stacking as parallel horizontals that the chandelier and the firebox split vertically.
contrast: ornament against plane, gilt frames on a bare stone field
warm leather against cool grey-white masonry
hard stone against soft fringed textiles
small dense shelf clutter against the wide empty wall above the mantel
images.focal: The eye goes straight to the wide monochrome riders painting on axis above the mantel, and the chandelier hanging directly over it locks the centre line.
images.balance: Objects pile up in the lower third and on the two flanking shelves, while the broad blank stone between the mantel and the ceiling gives the frame its rest.

subjects: stacked fire logs on a black grate
olive branches in a white pot
round black-framed mirror cropped by the frame
arched cane-front cabinet on an iron stand
open book on a chair arm
images.composition: Eye-level vantage from just off centre, the fireplace squared to the camera while three swivel chairs ring the foreground and crop at the bottom edge, the coffee table dominating the lower right.
texture: honed stone tray with a gilt rim
contrast: warm brass against cool grey stone and charcoal velvet
hard mineral wall against deep pile upholstery
the round table and round chair backs against the rectilinear stone coursing
matte black cabinet against a plain white plaster wall
images.focal: The brass drum base of the round coffee table pulls first as the only bright warm mass, then the black firebox opening behind it takes over and holds the middle distance.
images.balance: The stone wall carries all the visual noise across the top and right, and the flat white plaster wall at left plus the bare oak floor beneath the cabinet answer it.

subjects: black vessel with a polished gold rim and a stitched seam
round black-framed mirror reflecting dark ceiling beams and white ceiling
images.composition: Square-on close vantage with the mantel as a single horizontal near the lower third, the wall filling the frame edge to edge and the circle of the mirror cropped at the right.
texture: dry-stacked ledger stone with sawn faces
planed fir beam with visible grain and knots
contrast: busy stone coursing against three clean silhouettes
matte mineral against high-gloss metal
warm honey beam against cool grey stone
the mirror's flat reflected planes against the wall's relief
images.focal: The eye lands on the black vessel and the pair of brass candlesticks, the tallest candle tip carrying it up, and the mirror's dark edge stops it from leaving right.
images.balance: The right third is loaded with the mirror and the objects, and the wide empty run of stone at left, plus the uninterrupted beam beneath, pays for it.

subjects: phone held upright in a top-down shot
kitchen photograph with green cabinetry and a plaster range hood
text: Keep your inventory current – tap into your rooms below to manage items, edit details, and attach documents.
images.composition: Top-down vantage, the device centred and vertical against a horizontal wood grain, with a soft shadow falling up and to the left.
texture: rift-sawn oak with straight ribbon grain
veined marble in the on-screen counter
contrast: warm wood field against a cool white screen
one small dense rectangle against a large empty plane
the soft cast shadow against the flat grain
black bezel edging the bright display
images.focal: The lit phone screen is the only bright thing in the frame and the app's stacked cards and photograph carry the eye down its length.
images.balance: Everything happens in the narrow central column of the phone, and the broad unbroken oak on both sides is the rest that pays for it.

subjects: interior photo banner inside the screen
text: Select how you'd like to add your photo inventory:
Every detail counts. Fill in the essentials so you're always backed up.
images.composition: Straight overhead vantage, the phone centred and near-symmetrical in the square frame, the screen taking most of the height.
contrast: dark device against pale weave
flat glass against textile tooth
warm banner photograph against cool grey ground
images.focal: The eye lands on the lit white screen and is held by the dark stat row reading $23,575 and the bold Living Room heading directly under it.
images.balance: The middle third is busy where the interface stacks card on card, and the plain woven field around and below the phone rests, its shallow vignette pulling attention back inward.

text: Search assets by name, brand, category, tag, campaign...
images.composition: Three-quarter vantage from the left and slightly below, the laptop set right of centre on a shallow diagonal, the lid dominating the upper two thirds.
contrast: cool white interface against warm oak
hard sunlight against deep slat shadow
dense image grid against plain wood field
small red mark against a large neutral spread
images.focal: The eye lands on the bright screen and is held by the top row of faces, which run left to right across the grid and pull the read along with them.
images.balance: The screen carries nearly all the incident in its packed grid, and the broad empty plank at lower left plus the shadowed slatted back behind pay for it with two large unmarked areas.

text: Ask me about seasonal campaign ideas.
Why Ulta's Play Has a Weakness
images.composition: Low three-quarter vantage from the left, the laptop laid across the frame on a strong diagonal, the open lid filling the upper half and the keyboard the lower.
contrast: black keyboard against pale screen
warm tan floor against cool grey upholstery
text-dense panel against plain padded ground
single red pill against grey type
images.focal: The eye lands on the tilted screen at its brightest point and is held by the two red headings, then dropped to the red Send pill at the lower right.
images.balance: The screen's centre is dense with small grey type, and the wide unbroken chair back above it and the soft empty floor below carry no incident at all, which is what lets the text block read as the only event.

images.composition: Overhead vantage tilted off axis, the poster set on a diagonal and filling most of the frame, the table edge and its shadow cutting across the lower right corner.
contrast: ornament against plane
black ink against warm wood
hard geometric fills against loose script curves
busy lower field against empty upper paper
images.focal: The eye lands where the swashes knot at the centre and is held by the large dotted bowl beside them, the densest black in the sheet.
images.balance: The lower two thirds crowds with overlapping letterforms while the upper right stays bare white paper, and the plain dark wood running down the right edge gives the whole tangle a quiet border to sit against.

images.composition: Flat-on vantage, a centred square of six rows by six columns, symmetrical on both axes.
contrast: white marks against black field
regular grid against open margin
images.focal: The eye lands on the block of diamonds at centre and stays there, since nothing else occupies the field.
images.balance: All the incident sits in the centre square and the four black margins around it are equal and empty, so the grid reads as held rather than floating.

images.composition: Straight-on frontal vantage, near symmetrical about the framed panel, the black facade dominating while the campaign image holds the centre third.
contrast: saturated print against matte black plane
warm interior glow against cool grey street
carved ornament against flat panelled field
sharp storefront geometry against soft reflected facade
images.focal: The eye lands on the lit campaign panel and is held by the red mouth and pink blazer at its middle.
images.balance: The centre panel and the reflected building at right carry all the incident, and the wide black panelled base and empty paving below pay for them with flat quiet.

images.composition: Square frame split roughly down the middle, full-length figure at left against an extreme facial crop filling the right, the wordmark set on the seam.
contrast: sharp figure against blurred giant crop
cool pink against hot orange
small scale against enormous scale
thin white line against soft photographic wash
images.focal: The eye lands on the model's face at the left edge, then is dragged right to the red mouth in the enlarged crop.
images.balance: The left half is dense with figure, dots and drapery; the right half burns out to a near-empty wash, and that emptiness is what gives the thin type room to sit.

images.composition: Four square landscape frames butted into a 2x2 grid with seams crossing at the middle, the lockup centred on that crossing.
contrast: drawn mark against photographic field
vertical spines against horizontal ridgelines
bone white against olive dust
tangled foreground against smooth distant range
images.focal: The eye lands on the white skull mark at dead centre, held there by the four picture seams that cross behind it.
images.balance: Every quadrant is snarled with foreground growth; the banded mountains along the top and the pale bleached scrub at bottom right are the rests, and the mark takes the one quiet crossing.

images.composition: Landscape frame with a centred rectangular plate floating over a tiled repeat of a second horizon photograph, tagline set across the plate's midline.
contrast: single plate against repeating tile
dark evergreen mass against pale dead branches
cool sky against ochre grassland
crisp drawn arrows against soft distance
images.focal: The eye lands in the notch of pale sky between the two peaks at centre, and the outward-pointing arrows of the tagline hold it there.
images.balance: The left of the inner plate is a heavy dark canopy and the right an open lit slope; the border repeat is uniform enough to read as texture, which lets the centre plate breathe.

images.composition: Overhead flat-lay, plates set in a loose row with two cropped by the left and right edges, the largest charger dominating just left of centre.
contrast: geometric medallion against floral repeat
flat plane against banded rings
deep navy against pale cream
hard circle against an all-over field
images.focal: The eye lands on the large charger left of centre and is held by its bullseye of navy well and white geometric medallion.
images.balance: The background pattern runs busy edge to edge, and the plain navy and cream rings inside each plate are the only still areas, which is what lifts the plates off the field.

images.composition: Flat overhead vantage, plates arranged in two horizontal registers and cropped hard at both side edges, the stone's diagonal veining crossing under them.
contrast: ornament against plane
circle against diagonal vein
black field against pale stone
large plate against small stacked one
monochrome band against pink and green band
images.focal: The eye lands on the big plate left of centre, held by its concentric medallion sitting at the exact middle of the ring stack.
images.balance: The upper band gives four large plates room to breathe against open marble, and the lower band packs the small ware into a tight frieze that pays for that air.

images.composition: Raised three-quarter vantage looking down at a laptop set on the floor at a diagonal, the open screen taking the upper half of the frame.
contrast: warm slats against cool concrete
vertical ribbing against unbroken floor
lit screen against dim room
white type against dark photograph
images.focal: The eye lands on the lit screen and is held low-left by the stacked IVY PARK lockup, the brightest solid type in the frame.
images.balance: The left third beats out a dense vertical rhythm of battens, the right half is bare floor, and the laptop sits on the seam between them.

text: INTRODUCING A NEW ACTIVEWEAR BRAND DESIGNED TO SUPPORT WOMEN OF ALL SHAPES AND SIZES WITH EFFORTLESSLY COOL PIECES CUT FROM HIGH-PERFORMANCE TECHNICAL FABRICS.
THE ENTIRE LINE IS AVAILABLE IN A BROAD RANGE OF SIZES A
images.composition: Flat overhead grid of page layouts on white, three rows of unequal panels, several running off the right and left edges.
contrast: monochrome fields against cyan blocks
photographic grain against flat white gutters
condensed white type over dark image
cropped body against full figure
images.focal: The eye lands on the large stacked IVY PARK lockup at the top centre, held there by the lone full-length figure and her cast shadow beside it.
images.balance: The top and bottom rows are packed edge to edge, and the middle row opens up with white gutters and a small pair of product frames floating in the gap.

images.composition: Eye-level wide vantage from the flat, horizon low and centred, the single peak dominating and the range falling away right into low hills.
contrast: warm lit rock against cool sky
busy scrub against open air
sharp spines against soft cloud
grey shaded ridge against straw hillside
images.focal: The eye lands on the sunlit face of the peak right of centre, held by the dark fissures running down its shoulder.
images.balance: The lower half is a continuous mat of scrub with no rest in it, the upper half is open sky, and the broken rock band across the middle trades one for the other.

images.composition: High vantage from a bluff looking downriver, horizon set high with stacked pale ranges behind, sky taking the top third and the river entering at the lower right.
contrast: cool water against warm sand
dense brush against open channel
near detail against hazy distance
dark scrub against bleached bar
images.focal: The eye lands on the pale sandbar at the right and follows the channel's curve back into the haze.
images.balance: The left and bottom are crowded with brush, the water and the empty upper sky rest, and the flat sandbar between them carries the weight across.
